caption:
A one-star review lands in your inbox.

Google weighs response rate and speed as part of its local ranking signals, alongside your star rating. Silence reads worse to future customers than the complaint itself.

The 4-line reply framework:
1. Reply within 24 hours
2. Use their name once, skip the excuses
3. Name the fix in one sentence
4. Invite them to call or email, never negotiate in the comments

Do this for every review, good and bad. The pattern gets noticed more than any single reply.

Want every review collected and routed to you the moment it posts?

rationale: Fills under-served Education/Informative with an unclaimed tactic (negative review response script) grounded in Google's documented use of response rate/recency as a local ranking factor, using the reel format that still wins reach for cold-audience teaching content.
